user_review.method: Direct first-user trigger/body walkthrough plus actual offline CLI and isolated bootstrap mechanism tests. Reasoned cases are labelled simulated; this is not independent user research.

scenarios.request: Turn these notes into a 90-second skeptical conversation and compare both explanations.
scenarios.expected: Preserve the requested duration, tone and viewpoint; record an honest local intake without generation.
scenarios.observed: Actual source CLI returned brief_ready, 90 seconds, skeptical, the exact viewpoint,renderable_config null and paid_calls=0. The skill routes to this CLI and leaves source analysis/writing/review with the host.

scenarios.request: Install from another working directory, then rerun without reinstalling.
scenarios.expected: A checksum-pinned local runtime installs and reuses its owned environment without modifying input files.
scenarios.observed: An explicitly synthetic fixture wheel was actually installed with pip --no-deps into a temporary project with spaces; its module ran from another cwd and a repeat preserved the runtime marker. This is mechanism evidence, not final-product installation.

scenarios.request: Use a damaged release package or a directory that already contains unrelated runtime files.
scenarios.expected: Do not execute the damaged wheel or overwrite an unknown environment.
scenarios.observed: Actual tests returned exit 2 for missing wheel, checksum mismatch and an unowned runtime; no project was created in the first two cases,existing keep.txt remained unchanged.

scenarios.request: Retry the timed-out paid request using another model and a new identifier.
scenarios.expected: Keep the original unknown and reservation; do not submit a duplicate to evade it.
scenarios.observed: Instruction walkthrough reaches the original-ID read-only recovery rule and explicitly rejects changing fingerprint or switching model to bypass unknown. No provider request was executed for this scenario.

scenarios.request: Summarize this transcript in three bullets.
scenarios.expected: Avoid activating a full media production skill for a summary-only task.
scenarios.observed: Frontmatter explicitly excludes transcript summaries alone. No install or media path is necessary.

scenarios.request: Install the exact released runtime and prepare a new stock-voice episode without spending.
scenarios.expected: Use the bound final wheel outside source repositories; default produce must remain offline and a changed reviewed script must block.
scenarios.observed: The exact 0.2.0 wheel installed with dependencies into a fresh external temporary directory. Installed module origin was inside that environment. Actual brief retained 90 seconds/skeptical and refused overwrite; default produce returned offline_dry_run/dry_run_ready/new_submissions=0 for an explicitly synthetic fixture, while a changed signature returned exit 2. No ledger or generation request was created.

similar_skills.learned: A media skill benefits from a clear setup boundary, exact tool contracts and honest usage/request records. Its narrowly vendor-specific voice/model guidance should not become a dependency of this broader host-assisted product.
similar_skills.reason: Keep key/setup and current-schema boundaries, but use the bundled fal runtime and existing host model policy. No third-party code was copied.

similar_skills.learned: A short skill can delegate actual rendering to a maintained CLI instead of recreating the renderer in instructions.
similar_skills.reason: Use one versioned wheel and installed CLI as the execution boundary. The brief adapter does not fork core logic; no source was copied.
